label: VERIFIED
extraction: OpenCode Agent Skills Guide: Skills vs MCP distinction. MCP: external tools (browser, design, automation), permission control. Skills: internal workflows, reusable instructions, permission control. Rule: Use MCP when agent needs to do something outside OpenCode; Use Skills when agent needs to know how to do something consistently. Skill creation: .opencode/skills/git-release/SKILL.md. Frontmatter: name (required, matches folder), description (required), license/compatibility/metadata (optional). Naming rules: 1-64 chars, lowercase alphanumeric with single hyphens, no leading/trailing/consecutive hyphens. Skills advertised to agents, loaded on-demand via skill tool.
